revision_reason: Conform Q1-Q4 status values to the registered supported/contradicted/not_identified vocabulary; scientific judgments are unchanged.

scope_limits_by_question.Q1_observability: Supported only within the declared synthetic topology, lanes, detectors, endpoints and finite windows; no realistic long upstream freeway feeder state is observed.
scope_limits_by_question.Q2_freeway_side_impairment: EJMI is an exploratory sufficient signature and is not a formal Breakdown or Capacity Drop definition; not_identified does not mean no impairment.
scope_limits_by_question.Q3_urban_side_exposure: Supported as observed shared-road stopped exposure and U performance within the registered domain; causal additional U loss is not established.
scope_limits_by_question.Q4_same_scenario_tradeoff_basis: Not identified for the current structure, registered demand points and two seeds; other structures or conditions are not contradicted.

strict_obstacle: Within the current synthetic scaffold and registered demand points, A-window ramp passage changes from non-zero at qMain=3500 to zero at qMain=3650 while the preregistered local mainline EJMI is not identified at either point. The scenario therefore loses demand-window ramp passage before it presents the registered protectable mainline-side state.
general_scope_limits: Two seeds do not establish statistical robustness.
No controller benefit or sweet spot has been tested.
